column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each lighting and safety record.
A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), associating lighting/safety data with equipment.
An enum (LightingStatus_enum) describing the internal lighting state (e.g., Off, On, Auto).
A DECIMAL(5,2) showing the brightness level as a percentage.
An enum (ExternalLightStatus_enum) indicating external lighting state (e.g., Off, On, Auto).
An enum (EmergencyLightStatus_enum) describing emergency lighting (e.g., On, Off, Testing).
An enum (EmergencyStopStatus_enum) for the emergency stop button state (e.g., Activated, Reset, Ready).
An enum (AlarmStatus_enum) describing the overall alarm state (e.g., Normal, Critical, Warning).
An enum (SafetySystemStatus_enum) describing the overarching safety system state (e.g., Fault, Active, Standby).
An enum (LifeSupportStatus_enum) indicating the status of life support (e.g., Warning, Critical, Normal).
An enum (OxygenSupplyStatus_enum) showing oxygen supply level (e.g., Warning, Normal, Critical).
An enum (MedicalEquipmentStatus_enum) describing the medical equipment state (e.g., Normal, Critical, Warning).
An enum (WasteManagementStatus_enum) for waste disposal system health (e.g., Critical, Warning, Normal).
An enum (WaterSupplyStatus_enum) indicating water supply condition (e.g., Normal, Warning, Critical).
